title: Native Local Recipe Run
script: Welcome to this deep dive into Native Local Recipe Run. Part of PaperPilot's native Autonomous Automation suite, this tool provides deterministic, local-first execution. Engineered entirely in pure Rust, it operates with zero cloud egress, giving you complete data privacy, no SaaS subscription fees, and no external API rate limits. Now let us examine the input parameters and what each signifies. You configure input, an required parameter for Absolute path to the input PDF file.. In addition, recipe, an required parameter for Absolute path to a .ppflow TOML recipe file, preset ID, or serialized workflow.. In addition, name_template, an optional parameter for Optional dynamic output basename template; requires explicit output directory.. Every parameter is rigorously validated in memory before processing begins, ensuring safe, predictable transformations across all your documents. Next, output files and metrics. The tool emits optimized .pdf documents at Optional output PDF file path (or directory when name_template is provided).. By pruning redundant objects, deduplicating font streams, and applying memory-safe Rayon parallelism, it slashes document file size by up to eighty percent in under fifteen milliseconds, with zero bytes leaked to the cloud. You can deploy recipe_run across all five universal interfaces. First, drag and drop in the desktop dock for live inspection. Second, call it autonomously from Claude or AI agents through our native Model Context Protocol server. Third, run it directly in your terminal with the PaperPilot CLI. Fourth, trigger it via local REST API POST requests at localhost port 8080. And fifth, execute it client-side in your browser with zero-upload WebAssembly. Unlock total document privacy and native performance today. Visit usepaperpilot.com to explore recipe_run and all one hundred tools, run live interactive benchmarks, and download the bare-metal binary. Local-first document intelligence, powered by PaperPilot.
